tools.name: withdraw_listing_from_market
tools.description: Marks a listing as withdrawn and records the withdrawal reason on the listing. Permanently deletes all of its scheduled open houses.

params.name: listing_id
params.description: ID of the listing to withdraw.

params.name: reason
params.description: Why the seller is withdrawing the listing.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "listings.db"


@tool
def withdraw_listing_from_market(listing_id: int, reason: str) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    with conn:
        updated = conn.execute(
            "UPDATE listings SET status = 'withdrawn', withdrawal_reason = ?, withdrawn_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (reason, datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), listing_id),
        ).rowcount
        if updated == 0:
            conn.close()
            return f"Listing {listing_id} not found."
        removed = conn.execute("DELETE FROM open_houses WHERE listing_id = ?", (listing_id,)).rowcount
    conn.close()
    return f"Listing {listing_id} withdrawn; {removed} open house(s) removed."

tools.name: file_closed_deal_documents
tools.description: Moves all documents for a sold listing from the active-listings storage area into the closed-deals archive, then notifies the brokerage CRM by webhook that the deal file is complete, including the archived document locations.

params.name: listing_id
params.description: MLS listing ID of the sold property.

tools.code:
import os
import boto3
import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DOCUMENTS_BUCKET = os.environ.get("LISTING_DOCS_BUCKET", "brokerage-listing-documents")
CRM_WEBHOOK_URL = os.environ.get("CRM_CLOSED_DEAL_WEBHOOK", "https://crm.example-brokerage.com/hooks/closed-deals")

s3_client = boto3.client("s3")


@tool
def file_closed_deal_documents(listing_id: str, closing_date: str, sale_price: float) -> dict:
    active_listing_prefix = f"active/{listing_id}/"
    closing_year = closing_date[:4]
    closed_deal_prefix = f"closed/{closing_year}/{listing_id}/"

    paginator = s3_client.get_paginator("list_objects_v2")
    archived_document_keys = []
    for result_page in paginator.paginate(Bucket=DOCUMENTS_BUCKET, Prefix=active_listing_prefix):
        for document_object in result_page.get("Contents", []):
            original_document_key = document_object["Key"]
            relative_document_path = original_document_key[len(active_listing_prefix):]
            archived_document_key = closed_deal_prefix + relative_document_path
            s3_client.copy_object(
                Bucket=DOCUMENTS_BUCKET,
                CopySource={"Bucket": DOCUMENTS_BUCKET, "Key": original_document_key},
                Key=archived_document_key,
            )
            s3_client.delete_object(Bucket=DOCUMENTS_BUCKET, Key=original_document_key)
            archived_document_keys.append(archived_document_key)

    if not archived_document_keys:
        return {"listing_id": listing_id, "error": "No active documents found for this listing."}

    crm_notification_payload = {
        "event": "deal_file_closed",
        "listing_id": listing_id,
        "closing_date": closing_date,
        "sale_price": sale_price,
        "archive_location": f"s3://{DOCUMENTS_BUCKET}/{closed_deal_prefix}",
        "documents": archived_document_keys,
    }
    crm_webhook_response = requests.post(CRM_WEBHOOK_URL, json=crm_notification_payload, timeout=15)
    crm_notification_succeeded = crm_webhook_response.ok

    return {
        "listing_id": listing_id,
        "documents_archived": len(archived_document_keys),
        "archive_location": crm_notification_payload["archive_location"],
        "crm_notified": crm_notification_succeeded,
        "crm_status_code": crm_webhook_response.status_code,
    }

tools.name: add_co_listing_agent
tools.description: Gives another agent co-listing edit rights on a listing and charges the listing agent's saved card the co-listing fee.

params.name: co_agent_id
params.description: Agent ID of the agent being added as co-listing agent.

params.name: stripe_customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the listing agent paying the fee.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("listing-admin")
DB_PATH = "listings.db"


@mcp.tool()
def add_co_listing_agent(listing_id: str, co_agent_id: str, stripe_customer_id: str, fee_cents: int) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO listing_permissions (listing_id, agent_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'co_listing_editor')",
        (listing_id, co_agent_id),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    charge = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=fee_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=stripe_customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description=f"Co-listing fee for listing {listing_id} (agent {co_agent_id})",
    )
    return {"listing_id": listing_id, "co_agent_id": co_agent_id, "payment_intent": charge.id, "status": charge.status}
